faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Sainik School Chhingchhip, located in Chhingchhip, Mizoram, for hiring eligible candidates on contractual positions.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 5 vacancies have been announced, which include positions for Ward Boys (Male Only) and GE (Ayah) (Female Only).

faq.question: Q3. What is the essential qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Matriculation or an equivalent examination from any recognized Board to be eligible for applying to these positions.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for Sainik School Chhingchhip recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit ranges from a minimum of 18 years to a maximum of 50 years, calculated as on the last date for the receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to submit the offline application form?
faq.answer: The last date for the receipt of completed offline applications at the school address is 23-10-2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for all candidates?
faq.answer: All candidates are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 500/- in the form of a crossed Bank Draft or online payment receipt.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly offline. Candidates must download the form, fill it, and send it by post along with required documents.

faq.question: Q8. Where should the completed application form be sent?
faq.answer: The application form must be sent to The Principal, Sainik School Chhingchhip, Chhingchhip Village, Dist - Serchhip, Pin - 796161.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for Sainik School Chhingchhip recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a Written Exam and an Interview conducted specifically for short-listed candidates.

faq.question: Q10. What is the salary offered for the Ward Boys post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Ward Boys post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs 28,800/- per month on a contractual basis.
